messages:
alex: Quick question — tiny cleanup PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/4821
alex: I changed a couple of fields around api id casing and the linter is unhappy. only 3 files. can we decide snake_case vs camelCase for these JSON tags and fast-track? I can squash/rebase if we agree.

mira: which files? protobuf/json/Go structs?

alex: Go SDK and a small API handler. snippet:

```
type CreateRequest struct {
  ApiId string `json:\"api_id\"`
}
```

alex: originally it was ApiID -> `json:\"apiID\"` i changed the tag to api_id and renamed field to ApiId to match, but go vet/linter flags initialism (ID) style.

jon: we usually keep Go exported fields with ID capitalized: ApiID. JSON tags should be snake_case: `json:\"api_id\"`. So struct: `ApiID string `json:\"api_id\"``. keeps both conventions.

mira: +1 to jon. matches existing style guide (initialisms uppercase in Go). Add a short note in PR about rationale.

priya: i can approve after small test for json marshal/unmarshal and a one-line PR description explaining the naming rule.

alex: ok i'll add a test and update description. want to land before freeze at 17:00 PST — can someone quick-approve after i push?

ci-bot: ci/presubmit: all checks passed ✅

jon: looked, tests look fine. LGTM. :thumbsup:

mira: LGTM as well. approved.

alex: thanks all — will squash into one commit and merge after the push. leaving the merge to happen during the 10min merge window.

alex: merged and pushed. will monitor for regressions. :rocket:

priya: nice, thanks for handling the follow-up test and note.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: release pipeline kicked off for commit 9f3b2c.`
